CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository maintains the Unraid Community Applications template for **MetaTana**. It turns messy movie, TV, and anime folders into a clean, complete media library.
Add a folder and MetaTana identifies each title with trusted metadata providers and optional AI assistance. It fixes names and metadata, adds artwork, subtitles, trailers, cast, and crew, and writes player-ready NFO files. You review the result before anything moves.
MetaTana is local-first, metadata-only, and downloader-agnostic. It works with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, and Kodi.
**Support:** https://github.com/metatana/support/discussions
**Unraid setup guide:** https://metatana.com/install/unraid
